name: open-source-code-documenter
description: Mirror GitHub repos to GitLab and generate extensive documentation via multi-agent Cursor or Claude pipelines

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:3847/api/health && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.start:web: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production node dist/src/server/index.js
